headline: Iraq Stock Exchange Index Advances 1.75% in Weekly Trading
summary: The Iraq Stock Exchange benchmark RSISX index rose 1.75% in the trading week ending November 19, settling at 2,334.3 points in dinars and 1,993.2 points in US dollar terms.
why: The Iraq Stock Exchange tracks leading local banks, telecom, and industrial firms, reflecting domestic private liquidity and Iraqi financial sector activity.

impacts.name: ISX Index
impacts.why: Rabee Securities recorded a 1.75% weekly increase in the benchmark equity index.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Trading gains across listed Iraqi equities lifted the benchmark RSISX index by 1.75% over the week.
